side_effects.prevalence: Very common (reported by 30-50% of users in dataset)
management_tips: Keep track of bleeding patterns in a journal
Consult provider if heavy bleeding or lasts >7 days
side_effects.when_to_see_provider: Bleeding so heavy you need to change pad/tampon every hour, bleeding lasts >7 days, severe pain accompanies bleeding
side_effects.myth_buster: Irregular bleeding does NOT mean the method is ineffective or harming your body
side_effects.dataset_evidence: problem_bleeding and side_effect_bleeding reported across all age groups

side_effects.prevalence: Common (reported by 15-30% of users in dataset)
management_tips: Take pills at same time daily
side_effects.when_to_see_provider: Severe headaches with vision changes, new type of headache, headache with aura
side_effects.myth_buster: New or worsening headaches may indicate you need a different method - not that contraception is 'bad'

side_effects.prevalence: Moderate (reported by 10-20% of users in dataset)
management_tips: Discuss alternative methods if weight gain is concerning
side_effects.when_to_see_provider: Rapid or excessive weight gain (more than 5kg in 3 months)
side_effects.myth_buster: Most contraceptives do NOT cause significant weight gain - Depo-Provera is the main exception

side_effects.prevalence: Common (reported by 10-20% of users in dataset)
management_tips: Take pill with food or at bedtime
side_effects.when_to_see_provider: Severe nausea preventing eating/drinking, vomiting within 2 hours of taking pill (may need repeat dose)
side_effects.myth_buster: Nausea is typically temporary and often resolves as your body adjusts

side_effects.prevalence: Moderate (reported by 5-15% of users in dataset)
side_effects.when_to_see_provider: Severe back pain not responding to OTC medication, pain radiating down legs
side_effects.myth_buster: Backache is usually mild and temporary - not a sign of serious problems

side_effects.prevalence: Moderate (reported by 10-15% of users in dataset)
side_effects.when_to_see_provider: Severe fatigue affecting daily activities, signs of anemia (pale skin, shortness of breath)
side_effects.myth_buster: Fatigue is usually temporary - your body is adjusting to new hormone levels

side_effects.prevalence: Less common (reported by 5-10% of users in dataset)
side_effects.duration: May persist, but alternative methods available
management_tips: Non-hormonal methods (copper IUD, condoms) have no libido effects
side_effects.when_to_see_provider: Persistent loss of desire causing relationship distress
side_effects.myth_buster: If one hormonal method affects your libido, another may not - or you can switch to non-hormonal options

side_effects.prevalence: Depends on method - typical use effectiveness varies
management_tips: Use emergency contraception if method failed
Consider switching to more effective method
Take pregnancy test if period is late
side_effects.when_to_see_provider: Positive pregnancy test, missed period with method failure
side_effects.myth_buster: No method is 100% effective except abstinence, but LARC methods are 99% effective

side_effects.prevalence: Less common (reported by 5-10% of users in dataset)
side_effects.myth_buster: Sleep changes are usually temporary and may resolve as your body adjusts

side_effects.prevalence: Psychological (reported by 10-15% of users in dataset)
side_effects.duration: Based on misconception, not medical fact
management_tips: Understand that fertility returns after stopping
Depo-Provera may delay return by 6-12 months (temporary)
IUDs and implants: fertility returns immediately
side_effects.when_to_see_provider: Anxiety about fertility affecting quality of life
side_effects.myth_buster: Modern contraceptives do NOT cause permanent infertility. This is a MYTH - 94% of women in our dataset recognized this myth.

side_effects.prevalence: Psychological (reported by 5-10% of users in dataset)
side_effects.duration: Based on misconception, not medical fact
management_tips: Combined pills REDUCE ovarian/endometrial cancer risk
No evidence of increased cancer risk with implants/IUDs
Discuss individual risk factors with provider
side_effects.when_to_see_provider: Anxiety about cancer risk affecting quality of life
side_effects.myth_buster: Contraceptives do NOT cause cancer. Combined pills actually REDUCE risk of ovarian and endometrial cancer. This is a MYTH - 94% of women recognized it.

side_effects.prevalence: Common (reported by many users who stopped)
management_tips: Use backup method if not ready for pregnancy
Consult provider if no period for 3+ months after stopping Depo
side_effects.when_to_see_provider: No period for 6+ months after stopping hormonal method (except Depo - up to 12 months)
side_effects.myth_buster: Cycle changes after stopping are normal and temporary

management_tips: Most side effects are mild and temporary
Benefits outweigh risks for most women
